title: Fix EditorSpinSlider not showing tooltips
rationale: EditorSpinSlider::get_tooltip exists at editor/gui/editor_spin_slider.cpp:42 in pre-fix form; Range::get_tooltip base call applies cleanly.

title: Fix buttons in EditorProperty overlapping with values
rationale: Depends on absent EditorProperty name-sizing rework: name_fixed_size, old_use_folding_state, and EditorProperty theme_cache.horizontal_separation are undefined in the fork.

title: Fix credit roll in the project manager
rationale: Primary intent (credits_roll.cpp EditorNode-null fallback to ProjectManager::get_singleton + project_manager.h getter) is dead since PM startup was removed; only the editor_about.cpp easter-egg has_website guard is generally salvageable and needs hand-adaptation.

title: Fix wrong error fixed check
rationale: DependencyErrorDialog::_check_for_resolved still has the buggy `!errors_fixed` guard at editor/file_system/dependency_editor.cpp:905.

title: Fix audio bus name update
rationale: EditorAudioBuses ctor connects bus_layout_changed at editor/audio/editor_audio_buses.cpp:1462 but lacks the bus_renamed connect the fix adds.

title: Fix the credits not being centered
rationale: CreditsRoll ctor (editor/gui/credits_roll.cpp:241) creates content VBoxContainer without set_grow_direction_preset; general About easter-egg fix applies.

title: Fix shader loop detection for shader previewer
rationale: TextShaderPreview/_is_inside_loop shader previewer does not exist in editor/shader/ in the fork; depends on absent 4.7 shader-previewer feature.

title: Fix VU meter scale
rationale: Fork's EditorAudioBus VU meter predates the 4.7 gradient/peak-indicator rewrite (no peak_indicator_range, active_bus_texture, or Size2(16.0,128.0) in editor/audio/editor_audio_buses.{cpp,h}); target symbols absent.

title: Revert Fix EditorSpinSlider drag exceeding min/max boundaries
rationale: Fork's drag block (editor_spin_slider.cpp:134) already has no CLAMP and a diverged single set_value call, so it is already in the post-revert state.

title: Fix ShaderInclude selected in ShaderCreateDialog due to previous selection even if invalid
rationale: ShaderCreateDialog::config preferred/last_lang loops at editor/shader/shader_create_dialog.cpp:336/347 lack the Include+p_load_enabled guard; p_load_enabled param present.

title: Fix editor spin slider clamp
rationale: This CLAMP addition was reverted upstream by PR 118446; fork's drag block has no clamp and a diverged structure, so re-adding it would reintroduce the reverted bug.

title: Fix newly imported files not having existing UID assigned
rationale: Fix already present: editor/file_system/editor_file_system.cpp:931-950 already has id_known/has_id branching and ia.new_file->uid assignments.

title: Fix minimum height of Output buttons
rationale: Fork's EditorLog::_update_theme (editor/editor_log.cpp:114-117) sizes filter buttons via set_theme_type_variation("EditorLogFilterButton"); the patched set_custom_minimum_size(get_minimum_size_for_text_and_icon...) line no longer exists.

title: Fix unknown identifier source_texture in texture_blit visual shader
rationale: No TEXTURE_BLIT/texture_blit anywhere in scene/ or editor/; the texture_blit visual-shader mode is an absent 4.7 feature.

title: Fix audio bus send OptionButton height
rationale: EditorAudioBus::update_send at editor/audio/editor_audio_buses.cpp:230 still uses send->set_text(TTR("Speakers")); change to add_item applies (send OptionButton present).

title: Fix ShaderEditor's UI overflowing when shrunk
rationale: ShaderEditor is Control at editor/shader/shader_editor.h:39 (uses FOUNDRY_CLASS not GDCLASS) and the get_minimum_size overrides exist (text_shader_editor.h:210, visual_shader_editor_plugin.cpp:2538); needs FOUNDRY_CLASS base-class adaptation.

title: Fix Script Editor loses focus on esc in Find/Replace bar
rationale: Change is in generic FindReplaceBar::_hide_bar (editor/gui/code_editor.cpp:573-577), present verbatim in pre-fix form; not the diverged script-editor surface itself, self-contained grab_focus simplification.

title: Fix replace button doesn't highlight next occurrence
rationale: FindReplaceBar replace button still connects directly to _replace at editor/gui/code_editor.cpp:842; adding _replace_button_pressed applies cleanly.

title: Fix replace bar requiring pressing enter twice
rationale: replace_text (editor/gui/code_editor.cpp:831) lacks set_keep_editing_on_text_submit(true); LineEdit::set_keep_editing_on_text_submit exists (line_edit.h:300).

title: Fix custom importers do not work with singletons
rationale: EditorFileSystem::_first_scan_filesystem (editor/file_system/editor_file_system.cpp:357-361) still runs init_autoloads (step 3) before init_plugins (step 4); reorder applies.

title: Fix create dialog recents
rationale: Fix already present: CreateDialog::get_selected_type_name defined at editor/gui/create_dialog.cpp:635 and used by _confirmed/_item_selected/_favorite_toggled.

title: Fix blurry icons in the inspector dock's object selector
rationale: Fix already present: current_object_icon->set_v_size_flags(SIZE_SHRINK_CENTER) at editor/gui/editor_object_selector.cpp:231.

title: Fix EditorObjectSelector PopupMenu width
rationale: EditorObjectSelector::_show_popup (editor/gui/editor_object_selector.cpp:97-100) uses pre-fix get_screen_position and lacks set_shrink_width; PopupMenu::set_shrink_width exists (popup_menu.h:440).
